env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w

# A public decoder promoted through a private embedded value in another
# package decodes: the value-only path needs no field assignment, so the
# holder trials the resolved decoder.
logos run ./h
stdout '^ok wrapper x=11$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/imppriv

go 1.27

-- w/g/g.lgo --
package g

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
)

type decoder struct {
	X int64 `json:"x"`
}

func (d *decoder) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	var v map[string]int64
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &v); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	x, ok := v["x"]
	if !ok {
		return errors.New("decoder requires x")
	}
	d.X = x
	return nil
}

type Wrapper struct {
	decoder
}

type Plain struct {
	R float64
}

-- w/u/u.lgo --
package u

import "example.com/imppriv/g"

type Node interface {
	g.Wrapper | g.Plain
}

-- w/h/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"example.com/imppriv/g"
	"example.com/imppriv/u"
)

type Holder struct {
	Body   u.Node
	Status int = 200
}

func main() {
	var h Holder
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"Body":{"x":11}}`), &h); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("decode error:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	w, ok := h.Body.(g.Wrapper)
	if !ok {
		fmt.Printf("wrong member %T %+v\n", h.Body, h.Body)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Printf("ok wrapper x=%d\n", w.X)
}
